question.text: A particle is moving along the <math><mi>x</mi></math> -axis with its coordinate with time <math><mi>t</mi></math> given by <math><mi>x</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>t</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math> Another particle is moving along the <math><mi>y</mi></math> -axis with its coordinate as a function of time given by <math><mi>y</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>-</mo><mn>8</mn><msup><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math> At <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mo>,</mo></math> the speed of the second particle as measured in the frame of the first particle is given as <math><msqrt><mi>v</mi></msqrt><mo>.</mo></math> Then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>v</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math> is ___________.
